title: Fuobe Soul ID · character training
description: Train a character from a folder of photos you supply (local/characters/<name>/, 10–30 photos of one consenting person: no sunglasses, groups, filters or cropped faces, one full-body shot), then make N images of them. Identity is measured against the same photos. Set "consent": true in your copy only when the person agreed; demo runs don't train (they use reference images on drawn faces).

trained.description: The trained character LoRA, @mentioned in every prompt

original.description: The same element on the shipped Original (O3 retargets training to fuobe-soul)
